subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved by documenting the existing pi-tui newline behavior only, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already delegates Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J newline insertion to pi-tui, but configurable behavior would create a new public TUI config or CLI contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with default-compatibility tests and upgrade-safe docs.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui newline support as enough and close or narrow the issue if docs/help and configurability are intentionally out of scope.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined signal from prior issue review, original TUI ownership, pi-tui alignment history, and TUI docs work.
